artifacts.summary: Measures the live eager-load overage (68,289 B vs 65,950 B baseline, worse than the task description's snapshot), identifies the single highest-leverage trim (the 1,670 B /orchestrate table-cell in core's merge-sources/claudemd.md, duplicating docs/architecture/orchestrate-state-machine.md), finds a second genuine duplicate in skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md (detected_defects/AskUserQuestion restated twice) to close its 325 B ceiling overage alongside the task-named 3-row collapse, confirms the hard-mode promotion precondition (sibling task 293 completed) is satisfied, and recommends trim-not-baseline-move with a strict do-trims-then-flip-mode ordering.

memory_candidates.content: verify-deploy.sh Gate 20's measure-eager-context.sh classifies eager content via four channels (parent CLAUDE.md chain, predicted assembled .claude/CLAUDE.md, @-imports, rules/*.md with a paths: glob matching specs/** or .claude/**). docs/architecture/*.md and context/patterns/*.md are NOT eager under this model (only agent-system/extensions/*/rules/*.md is scanned for the rules channel), so pointer-extraction from a merge-sources/claudemd.md fragment or a rules/*.md file into docs/ or context/patterns/ is a reliable way to shrink the eager-load total without content loss.

When checking whether a config-recorded 'deferred until sibling task X settles' precondition is satisfied, the authoritative check is state.json's active_projects status for X (and for any OTHER task whose file_scope also names the contested file) plus git log on the contested file to find the actual most recent editor -- not just assuming the config comment's date is still current. test files for such gates (e.g. test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh) often already exercise both the pre- and post-promotion severity via explicit env-var overrides per case rather than relying on the script's own default, so flipping a default value is usually safe to verify by reading the test harness rather than guessing.

context_gaps.gap: No context/patterns/ file catalogues known-safe eager-context trim candidates (duplicate constraint restatements, oversized table cells duplicating a docs/architecture/*.md reference). This report had to re-derive two such duplicates by direct byte measurement and manual reading.
context_gaps.recommendation: Consider a future context/patterns/eager-context-trim-candidates.md if overage cycles recur (this appears to be at least the second cycle against this gate per the stale specs/ROADMAP.md Budgets snapshot).
